issues.detail: The Hebrew name בְּאֵרִי (Beeri) is rendered as '比以利' (Bǐyǐlì), which is a mis-transliteration; the standard Chinese rendering should be '比珥利' or similar, but more importantly the name is not '比以利'.

The Hebrew אֵילֹן (Elon) is a personal name (Elon the Hittite), not '以倫樹林' (Elon forest/woodland). The Chinese adds '樹林' (forest) which is not in the Hebrew and changes the proper name into a place description.
